Save appearance, favorites, tile order, Home shortcuts, sounds and custom wallpaper to a ZIP file on USB or another location you choose.\n\nThe copy includes your greeting name, favorite app packages and weather city. Keep it private. Apps, launch history, firmware settings and permissions are not included. No automatic upload.
There is no previous restore to undo.
This firmware has no compatible file picker. Your settings have not changed.

Operation failed. Check the file and available space. A MetoxTV backup must be a valid ZIP of up to 6 MB. If a restore failed after it started, use “Undo the last restore” to recover the previous copy.

Backup validated. Saved settings: %1$d; files: %2$d.

Your current portable settings, Home shortcuts and wallpaper will be replaced. Missing choices return to their defaults. Apps stay installed. A local copy of the current settings will be saved first; you can undo this restore.

Firmware settings and permissions are excluded.
Settings restored. Return to Home to apply them. You can undo this restore here.
Restore cancelled. Your settings have not changed.
Backup checked. Confirm the restore or cancel.
Backup saved to the location you selected.
Motion settings saved. Return to Home to apply them. This changes launcher effects only.
Idle clock setting saved. The timer runs only on Home; it does not interrupt apps or video.
Remove locally saved app launch times? Favorites and tile order will stay. This does not clear the history inside your apps.
New launches will not be recorded. Existing history remains until you clear it.
Launches from MetoxTV will be recorded locally. Apps opened by other means are not tracked.

Arrow keys move focus; OK opens an app. Hold OK on a tile for favorites, moving, Home shortcuts and app information.

The magnifying glass at the top opens search. Search works offline with app names, package names and Russian transliteration: try “kino” for “Кинопоиск”. Recent lists launches made through MetoxTV.

Press + in favorites to choose apps. Hold OK on a favorite to move it or remove its shortcut.

Before changing your layout, save a backup in Tools. You can restore it from USB and undo the last restore.

If focus feels slow, select Fast under Motion and performance. Home changes apply when you return from settings.

Tools also contains weather, APK installation and diagnostics. The stock Home screen remains available through your TV settings.
